{{Quote|Looks like a older model, you better check its encryption codes.|The officer to a [[Unidentified Imperial technician (Tellstar)|technician]]|<ref name="Rebel Resolve" />}}
This '''Imperial officer''' was stationed aboard the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[light cruiser]] ''[[Tellstar]]'' above [[Lothal]] in [[4 BBY]]. After being informed by a [[Unidentified Imperial technician (Tellstar)|technician]] that the [[astromech droid]] [[Courier droid|courier]] [[264]] was malfunctioning, he asked what was wrong with the [[droid]], suggesting that the technician check its decryption. "264" was actually the rebel droid [[C1-10P|Chopper]], undercover to access the Empire's data network. Before the technician could inspect Chopper, the [[Corellian]] [[VCX-100 light freighter|VCX-100]] ''[[Ghost]]'' attacked the light [[cruiser]] on his signal.<ref name="Rebel Resolve" />
